bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)
test -n "$cid"
docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' "$cid"
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),crypto=require("crypto");const p="/app/runtime/teaching-parallel-20261128-0955/status.json";const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p));const w=require("/app/server/command-module/teaching-weight-registry.js").readWeightManifest();console.log(JSON.stringify({status:s.status,updated_at:s.updated_at,cost:s.cost_usd,lessons:s.lessons.map(x=>({topic:x.topic,status:x.status,verdict:x.verdict,phase:x.phase,error:x.error})),dispatches:s.dispatches.map(x=>({model:x.model,http_status:x.http_status})),weight_update:w.weight_update,weight_status:w.weight_status,student_model_gate:w.student_model_gate,optimizer_steps:w.optimizer_steps,holdout_loss_before:w.holdout_loss_before,holdout_loss_after:w.holdout_loss_after,cli_sha256:crypto.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync("/app/server/command-module/teaching-batch-cli.cjs")).digest("hex")}));'
